scripts.name: scripts/rootfs/buildroot/make_parted.sh
scripts.device_identity_checks: enumerates nonzero removable block devices with DRIVER=sd and prompts for a device; no model/serial/capacity binding
scripts.evaluated_layout: with MLK_BOOTSCR_NAME=parameter-tf-fat.txt (not containing ext4), one FAT32 partition from 0% to 100%, boot flag

scripts.name: scripts/rootfs/buildroot/deploy_image.sh
scripts.device_identity_checks: enumerates removable DRIVER=sd devices and prompts for a device; no model/serial/capacity binding
scripts.evaluated_behavior: partition 1 must be vfat and receives MLK_IMAGES_DIR/boot; partition 2 must be ext4 and receives rootfs.tar.gz, but this is not used by the parameter-tf-fat one-partition layout

scripts.name: boards/DR1M/configs/parameter-tf-fat.txt
scripts.boot_contract: mmc part; load uImage.lz4, uInitrd.lz4 and system.dtb; bootm; console ttyS0 and alspinor mtdparts

scripts.name: scripts/rootfs/buildroot/create_image.sh
scripts.behavior: dispatches to create_dr1m_image.sh for ARCH=arm64; no block-device operations in this script

scripts.name: scripts/rootfs/buildroot/create_dr1m_image.sh
scripts.behavior: uses fsbl.elf, system.bit, u-boot.bin, bootgen/albg and mkimage to create BOOT.bin/boot.scr and copy boot/rootfs artifacts into MLK_IMAGES_DIR

scripts.name: boards/DR1M/buildroot/images/boot/boot.scr
scripts.behavior: U-Boot script loads uImage.lz4, uInitrd.lz4 and system.dtb from mmc boot partition
